verses.en: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
verses.sm: Ua faatonu atu e Iesu i mea e tusa ona fai i le sapati Iesu i tosaito i le sapati; ua fia aai foi ona soo, ona ooti ai lea e i latou o ‘au saito, ma aai ai.

verses.en: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
verses.sm: Ua iloa atu e le au faresaio, ona latou faapea atu ai lea ia te ia, “Faauta, ua faia e ou soo le mea e sa ona fai i le sapati.”

verses.en: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu o ia ia te i latou, “E lei faitaulia ea e outou le mea na faia e Tavita, ina ua fia ‘ai o ia, atoa ma i latou sa ia te ia;

verses.en: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.sm: na ulufale ia i le fale o le Atua, na ‘ai foi e ia areto ua laulauina i luma, o mea e sa ona ‘ai ai o ia, atoa ma i latou sa ia te ia, e gata lava i le au ositaulaga?

verses.en: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
verses.sm: E lei faitaulia ea foi e outou ile tulafono, o sapati uma ua solia ai le sapati e le au ositaulaga i le malumalu, a e le sala i latou?

verses.en: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu foi ia te outou, O iinei le ua sili i le malumalu.

verses.en: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.sm: Ana outou iloa le uiga o lea upu, Ou te loto i le alofa, a e le o le taulaga, po ua outou le faasalaina o e le sala.

verses.en: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
verses.sm: Aua o le Atalii o le tagata, o le alii lava ia o le sapati.”

verses.en: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
verses.sm: Ua maliu ese ia i lea mea, ona ulu atu ai Lea o ia i lo latou sunako.

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, sa i ai le tagata ua gase lona lima; ona latou fesili mai ai lea ia te ia, “E tatau ca ona faamalolo i le sapati?” ina ia latou momoli ia te ia.

verses.en: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, “O ai ea so outou e ana le mamoe e tasi, afai foi e pau o ia i le lua i le sapati, e le tago ea i ai, ma avae i luga?

verses.en: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
verses.sm: E le sili lava ea le tagata i le mamoe? O lea e tatau ai ona agalelei i le sapati.”

verses.en: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia i le tagata, “Ina faaloaloa ia o lou lima.” Ona faaloaloa ai lea e ia, ona toe lelei ai lea, ua pei o le tasi.

verses.en: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.sm: A ua o i fafo le au faresaio, ona latou taupulepule ai lea ia te ia, ina ia latou fasioti ia te ia.

verses.en: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
verses.sm: A ua silafia > Iesu, ona maliu ese ai lea o ia i lea mea; ua mulimuli mai foi ia te 12 le motu o tagata e toatele; ona faamaloloina ai lea e ia o i latou urna;

verses.en: And charged them that they should not make him known:
verses.sm: ua matua fetalai atu foi o ia ia te i latou, aua neʻi latou faalaua‘i tele ia;

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.sm: ina ia taunuu ai le upu a le perofeta o Isaia, ua faapea mai:

verses.en: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.sm: Faauta, o lau auauna na ou filifilia, o lau pele o loo fiafia i ai loʻu loto; ou te tuuina atu loʻu Agaga i ona luga, e faailoa atu e ia le faamasinoga inuu ese;

verses.en: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
verses.sm: e le finau ia, e le alaga foi o ia, e le lagona foi lona leo e se tasi i ala.

verses.en: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
verses.sm: E le gagau e ia le u ua gapepe, e ie tinei foi e ia le vavae ua mu itiiti; seia faamanumalo e ia le faamasinega.

verses.en: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.sm: O lona igoa foi e }aatoetrde i ai tuu ese.

verses.en: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
verses.sm: Ona aumaia lea ia te ia o le tagata ua uluitinoina e le temoni, o le tauaso foi o ia ma gūgū; ona faamaloloina ai lea e ia o ia, ona tautala ai lea ma vaai lē sa tauaso ma gūgū.

verses.en: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
verses.sm: Ona taufaiofo ai lea o le motu o tagata uma, ua faapea ane, “Po o le atalii ea lenei o Tavita?”

verses.en: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
verses.sm: A ua lagona e le au faresaio, ona latou fai ane ai lea, Ana le se anoa Pelesepulo le alii o temoni, e le tulia e lena tagata o temoni.”

verses.en: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
verses.sm: A ua silafia e Iesu o latou manatunatu, ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, “O malo uma ua fevaevacai e faaumatia ia; o aai uma foi po o aiga e fevaevacai e lë tumau ia.

verses.en: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
verses.sm: Afai foi e tulia e Satani ia Satani, ona fevaevaeai lea o la la te la; pe faapefea foi ona tumau o lona malo?

verses.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.sm: Afai foi o Pelesepulo ou te tulia ai e a‘u temoni, po o ai ua tulia ai temoni e a outou fanau? O le mea lea e fai ai i latou ma faamasino ia te outou.

verses.en: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
verses.sm: A e afai o le Agaga o le Atua ou te tulia ai e au o temoni, ua oo mai lava ia te outou le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
verses.sm: E mafai faapefea se tasi ona ulu atu i le fale o le tagata malosi, ma vete ana mea? Seia muai fusifusia le tagata malosi, i le vete ai lona fale.

verses.en: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
verses.sm: O se le “au ia te au, e “au ese lea ia te au; o se le faaputu faatasi ma a'u, e faataapeape lea.

verses.en: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te fai atu ai ia te outou, O agasala uma ma upu faifai e faamagaloina ia i tagata; a o le faifai i le Agaga, E le faamagaloina lea i tagata.

verses.en: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
verses.sm: Ai sé fai upu i le Atalii o le tagata, e faamagaloina lea; a o lè fai upu i le Agaga Paia, e le faamagaloina lea i le olaga nei po o le atali.

verses.en: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
verses.sm: “Ia outou taʻua le laau e lelei, ma ona fua foi e lelei; a le o lea, ia outou taʻua le laau e leaga, ma ona fua foi e leaga; auā o ona fua ua iloga ai le laau.

verses.en: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
verses.sm: Fanau a gata feai e, outou o loo leaga, e mafaia faapefea ona outou upu lelei? Auā o le tele o mea i le loto e tautala mai ai le gutu.

verses.en: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
verses.sm: Ua au mai mea lelei e le tagata amio lelei i mea lelei ua teu i lona loto; o le tagata amio leaga foi, ua au mai mea leaga i mea leaga ua teu i lona loto.

verses.en: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
verses.sm: A ou te fai atu ia te outou, o upu faatauvaa uma e faia e tagata, latou te talatala atu ai le tala i le aso faamasino.

verses.en: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
verses.sm: Auā o au upu e ta'uamiotonuina ai oe, o au upu foi e faasalaina ai oe.”

verses.en: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o isi o le au tusiupu ma le au faresaio, “Le aʻoaʻo e, ua matou fia iloa se faailoga ia te oe.”

verses.en: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
verses.sm: A ua tali atu o ia, “O le tupulaga leaga ma le mulilulua ua latou sailia mai se faailoga; a e leai se faailoga e avatua i ai, ua na o le faailoga o Iona le perofeta.

verses.en: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.sm: Auā e pei o Iona sa i le manava o le ifa tele i ao e tolu ma po e tolu, e faapea foi ona i ai o le Atalii o le tagata i lalo i le eleele i ao e tolu ma po e tolu.

verses.en: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
verses.sm: E tutū mai tagata o Nineva i le faamasinoga faatasi ma le tupulaga nei, e faasala i ai; auā na latou salamo i le talaʻiga a Iona; faauta foi, o iinei lē sili ia Iona.

verses.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.sm: E tutū mai faatasi le tupu fafine o le itu i toga ma le tupulaga nei i le faamasinoga, e faasala i ai; auā na sau o ia mai tulu‘iga o le lalolagi e faalogologo i le poto o Solomona; faauta foi, o iinei lē sili ia Solomona.

verses.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
verses.sm: “Pe a alu i fafo i le tagata le agaga leaga, ona fealuai ai lea o ia i nuu naumati, ua saili se malologa, a e le maua.

verses.en: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
verses.sm: Ona faapea ane ai lea o ia, Ou te foi atu i loʻu fale na ou sau ai; ua alu i ai, ona iloa ai lea ua tuufua, ua uma foi ona tafitafi ma teuteu.

verses.en: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o ia, ua na aumaia isi agaga e toafitu e sili lo latou leaga i lona, ona latou ulufale atu ai lea, ua nonofo ai; ona sili ai lea ona leaga le tulaga o lea tagata i lo le tulaga muamua. E faapea foi ona fai i lenei tupulaga leaga.”

verses.en: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
verses.sm: Ua tautala ia i le motu o tagata, faauta, ua tutū mai i fafo o lona tinā ma ona uso, ua fia tautala ma ia.

verses.en: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o le tasi ia te ia, “Faauta, ua tutū mai i fafo lou tinā ma ou uso, ua fia tautala ma oe.”

verses.en: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
verses.sm: Ona tali atu ai lea o ia, ua faapea atu i le na taʻu mai ia te ia, “O ai ea loʻu tina? O ai foi oʻu uso?”

verses.en: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.sm: Ona faaloaloa ai lea e ia o lona aao i ona soo, ua faapea atu, “Faauta, o loʻu tinā ma oʻu uso,

verses.en: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
verses.sm: aua o lē faia le finagalo o loʻu Tamā o i le lagi, o loʻu uso lea, ma loʻu tuafafine, ma loʻu tina.”
